propositions: Pandoc 3.6.1 silently corrupts wiki output by escaping punctuation inside code spans, deleting HTML comments, and rewriting delimiters like `-->` to `-→` when naive arrow substitution is applied

A deterministic, fixed-seed corpus of 178 wiki bodies (29 code-arrow, 29 table, 120 prose) must stabilize after one render with body ratio >=0.90 and character ratio >=0.95, with all code fragments and HTML comments surviving byte-exact

The renderer must implement two-phase lexing that locks HTML comments, code fences, backtick/tilde spans, and four-space blocks before classifying remaining units into safe pass-through, table wrapping, or pandoc conversion paths

A post-render code-preservation check must verify every source code fragment appears verbatim in the output; if any fragment is corrupted, the entire unit falls back to identity to prevent pandoc escaping quirks from corrupting content

The renderer must split inline Jira wiki markers into unambiguous forms (`{{…}}`, `[label|target]`, `{color:…}`) that settle a unit alone, and ambiguous forms (`*x*`, `_x_`) that only settle if the unit has no CommonMark-only markers, to prevent 2-cycle re-rendering instability
